title: Filtered colimits of abelian groups are exact
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and $A_\bullet\to B_\bullet\to C_\bullet$ a sequence of functors $J\to\mathrm{Ab}$ with natural transformations which is exact at $B_j$ for every $j$. Then $\varinjlim_JA\to\varinjlim_JB\to\varinjlim_JC$ is exact. Consequently the filtered colimit of a system of long exact sequences of abelian groups (with compatible maps) is a long exact sequence.
